cases.situation: We run a small online candle shop. A label mix-up meant about 180 Fig & Cedar candles went out labelled Lavender between Sept 14 and 22. People are posting about it on Instagram. Labels are now checked against the batch sheet before every run. I'm the founder, Priya.
cases.reply: Between 14 and 22 September, about 180 candles we sent as Lavender were actually Fig & Cedar with the wrong label. If yours smells woody rather than floral, that's why. Sorry, that's our mistake. Everyone affected gets the right candle shipped free by 9 October, no action needed, and you can keep the Fig & Cedar. Labels are now checked against the batch sheet before every run. Not heard from us by Friday? Email hello@example.com and I'll sort it personally. Priya, founder
cases.note: Small mistake, short post: what happened first, one sorry, then the automatic fix.

cases.situation: 我们是一家火锅店。9月20日起为了控制成本换了新的底料供应商，也没提前告诉大家，很多老顾客在会员群和小红书上说味道变了。我们决定10月1日起换回原来的底料，9月20日到30日来吃过的会员下次到店送一份锅底，以后换主要原料前先请会员试吃。我是店长陈磊，想在会员群和小红书发一条说明。
cases.reply: 9月20日起，我们为了控制成本换了底料，也没提前跟大家说，很多老顾客一吃就吃出来了：味道变了。对不起，这个决定是我们做的，责任在店里。10月1日起换回原来的底料。9月20日到30日来吃过的会员，下次到店报手机号就送一份锅底，不需要任何凭证。以后换任何主要原料，我们都会先请会员试吃再定。有想法直接在群里@我或私信店铺。店长 陈磊
cases.note: 为自己的经营决定道歉：说清改了什么、为什么，不把责任推给供应商，然后撤回决定并给出一条做得到的改变。

cases.situation: We posted an apology after our meal-kit deliveries were two days late last week. The top comment says 'Words are cheap. Third time this year.' It's actually the second time. Everyone affected got a free box credited, and we've added a second courier for Thursday deliveries. I'm the founder.
cases.reply: Fair, and you're right to be fed up. It's been two late weeks this year, and that's two too many. Here's what's done so far: everyone affected has a free box credited to their account, and we've added a second courier for Thursday deliveries. I'll post an update on 13 October with our on-time rate since the change.
cases.note: Agree with the feeling, correct the fact once without arguing, then point to actions and a dated update. Then post it.

cases.situation: I own a small yoga studio. This morning I sent our class schedule email from my personal email instead of our mailing tool and put all 212 members in the To line instead of BCC, so everyone's email addresses are visible. No other data. From now on every studio email goes through the mailing tool, which hides addresses. I want to email everyone.
cases.reply:
Subject: An email mistake this morning, and what we've done
Hi everyone,
At 8:40 this morning our schedule email went to 212 members with every address visible, instead of hidden. Only email addresses were shared: no phone numbers, no payment details, nothing else. I'm sorry, that was my mistake, sending from my own account instead of our mailing tool. From now on every studio email goes through the mailing tool, which never shows addresses. Please delete this morning's email, and if anything odd arrives that seems to come from this list, reply here or call me on 0161 496 0732.
Maya, owner, Northside Yoga
cases.note: A small data slip still gets its own email: exactly what was and wasn't shared, one sorry, one real change. Check your local notification rules before sending.

cases.situation: Wir betreiben eine Kletterhalle in Leipzig. Am Samstag mussten wir wegen eines Wasserschadens schließen, haben das aber erst um 9 Uhr auf Instagram gepostet. Rund 60 Leute standen vor der Tür. Künftig melden wir Schließungen auch per E-Mail, SMS und auf der Startseite. Ich bin der Inhaber, Jonas.
cases.reply:
Am Samstag, 26. September, war unsere Halle wegen eines Wasserschadens geschlossen, und wir haben das erst um 9 Uhr auf Instagram gepostet, als viele von euch schon vor der Tür standen. Rund 60 Leute sind umsonst gekommen. Das tut mir leid. Alle, die für Samstag gebucht hatten, bekommen den Eintritt bis Freitag, 2. Oktober, automatisch erstattet. Wer ohne Buchung da war, schreibt uns an hallo@example.com und bekommt einen Freieintritt. Schließungen schicken wir ab sofort per E-Mail und SMS an alle Buchungen und stellen sie auf die Startseite, nicht nur auf Instagram. Bei Fragen erreicht ihr mich direkt unter 0341 2298 410.
Jonas Berger, Inhaber
cases.note: Local business, informal 'ihr': the refund is automatic and the fix is about the channel that failed.

cases.situation: Our bakery's Instagram posted a joke yesterday calling gluten-free customers 'crazy'. A coeliac customer called it out and it's been shared about 300 times. I'm the owner, Dana, and I wrote the post. It's deleted, and from today a second person on the team checks every post.
cases.reply: Yesterday this account posted a joke calling gluten-free customers 'crazy'. I wrote it, and it was wrong: for people with coeliac disease gluten-free is a medical need, and many of you trust us with exactly that. I'm sorry. The post is deleted, and from today every post is checked by a second person on our team before it goes up. If you want to tell me directly how this landed, I read every email at dana@example.com. Dana, owner
cases.note: The owner names herself as the author; no 'it was meant as a joke' defence.

cases.situation: 我们是一家线上咖啡豆小店。9月26日到28日发出的一批耶加雪菲（批次0926）烘焙过度，有明显焦苦味，一共92单，已经有客人在小红书上说了。我是店主林悦，想发一条给这批客人的消息，同时挂在店铺首页。以后每一锅出炉都会先杯测再装袋。
cases.reply: 9月26日至28日发出的耶加雪菲（批次0926）烘焙过度，喝起来有明显的焦苦味，一共影响92位客人。对不起，这是我们的问题。10月2日（周五）前，我们会给每位客人免费寄出一包新烘的豆子，不需要任何操作；如果您更想退款，直接回复“退款”，当天处理。从这批开始，每一锅出炉后都会先杯测再装袋。有任何问题，私信店铺或加我微信 linyue_beans，我亲自回复。店主 林悦
cases.note: 先说发生了什么、影响多少人，一句道歉，补救自动完成，改进只写一条做得到的。

cases.situation: I run Ledgerly, a small invoicing app for about 4,000 freelancers. Yesterday, Monday, from 10am to 2:30pm nobody could send invoices because a database update failed, and about 900 invoices went out hours late. Delayed invoices kept their original date, and we now test every update on a copy of live data and roll back automatically after 10 minutes of errors. I'm the founder and want to post on LinkedIn and X.
cases.reply: Yesterday from 10am to 2:30pm, nobody could send invoices from Ledgerly, and about 900 invoices went out hours late. Sorry, that's on us: a database update failed. Every delayed invoice kept its original date, so your payment terms aren't affected. We now test every update on a copy of live data first, and roll back automatically after 10 minutes of errors. If a client says yours never arrived, email me at sam@example.com and I'll sort it the same day. Sam, founder
cases.note: Match the size: a half-day outage gets a short post, one sorry, and a change you can actually verify.

cases.situation: We run Ridgeback Outdoor, a small online gear shop. From Sunday evening to Monday afternoon our site showed the Trailbase 3-person tent at $39 instead of $390, a typo in a bulk price update. 62 orders came in and we're honouring them, but people who saw the price jump mid-checkout are annoyed on Facebook. From now on a second person checks every bulk price change. I'm the owner, Sam.
cases.reply: From Sunday evening until Monday afternoon, our site showed the Trailbase 3-person tent at $39 instead of $390, after a typo in a price update. We're honouring all 62 orders placed at that price, and they ship this week. Sorry to anyone who watched the price change mid-checkout; that's a frustrating thing to see. From now on, a second person checks every bulk price change before it goes live. Questions: sam@example.com. Sam, owner.
cases.note: A pricing slip needs a short post: the facts, one sorry, what you're honouring, and one check you can actually keep.

cases.situation: We're a two-person studio making a card game, Tidepool. Our launch page and the printed boxes credit the reef card art to the wrong illustrator, and the real artist, Mara Lind, pointed it out publicly yesterday. The page is fixed, every copy will ship with a card crediting her, and credits are now checked against artist contracts before anything is published. I'm co-founder Leah and want to post an update to our 1,400 backers.
cases.reply:
The reef cards in Tidepool were illustrated by Mara Lind, and our launch page and box credited someone else. That's our mistake, and we're sorry, Mara; your name should have been there from the start. The launch page now credits her correctly. The boxes are already printed, so every copy will ship with a card crediting Mara for the reef art. From now on every credit is checked against the artist's contract before anything is published. If you spot anything else we've got wrong, email hello@example.com.
Leah, co-founder
cases.note: When the person wronged is a collaborator, the correction comes first: put their name right before anything else, then the fix customers will see.

cases.situation: We run Marlow Books. At our author event on Saturday the step-free side door was locked and nobody was on it, so a wheelchair user, Dee, waited 25 minutes outside and missed the reading. She posted about it on Instagram and tagged us. I've DMed her offering a ticket refund and a signed copy of the book, and from this week the side door is unlocked and staffed from 30 minutes before every event. I'm the owner, Sophie.
cases.reply: Dee, you're right and I'm sorry. On Saturday our step-free door was locked with nobody there to open it, so you waited 25 minutes outside and missed the reading you came for. That's on us as a shop. I've sent you a DM to refund your ticket and to send you a signed copy of the book if you'd like one. From this week the side door is unlocked and staffed from 30 minutes before every event. Sophie, owner.
cases.note: Reply where she posted, own it as the business without blaming a staff member, name one concrete change, and move the refund to DM.

cases.situation: 我们是一家连锁瑜伽馆，会员都在小程序上续费。9月28日续费系统出错，大约310位月卡会员被重复扣了一次月费，每人299元。已经有会员在群里和小红书上问了。从今天起每次扣款前系统都会先核对重复订单。我是创始人周蔓，想发一条公告。
cases.reply: 9月28日，我们小程序的续费系统出错，约310位月卡会员被重复扣了一次299元的月费。对不起，这是我们的问题。多扣的款会在10月2日（周五）前原路退回，不需要任何操作。从今天起，每次续费扣款前系统都会先核对有没有重复订单。10月2日后还没收到退款，请私信小程序客服或加我微信 zhouman_yoga，我亲自处理。创始人 周蔓
cases.note: 扣错钱的道歉：先说金额和人数，一句道歉，退款自动完成并给出日期，改进只写一条做得到的。

cases.situation: We run Butter & Rye, a bakery. Our 'nut-free' oat cookies sold on Saturday and Sunday (Sept 26 and 27) were baked on trays also used for almond biscotti, so they may contain traces of almond. About 70 were sold and nobody has reported a reaction yet. We've pulled the batch, nut-free bakes now have their own trays and go in the oven first, and anyone who bought them gets a full refund. I'm the owner, Grace (0117 496 0215), and want to post on Instagram, our website and a sign in the shop.
cases.reply: If you bought our oat cookies labelled 'nut-free' on Saturday 26 or Sunday 27 September, please don't give them to anyone with a nut allergy. If someone has eaten one and is having a reaction, get medical help now, and call emergency services if it's severe. They were baked on trays also used for almond biscotti and may contain traces of almond; about 70 were sold. I'm sorry, that's our mistake. We've pulled the batch, and from today nut-free bakes have their own trays and go in the oven before anything with nuts. Bring the cookies back, or just tell us you bought them, for a full refund. To talk to me directly, call 0117 496 0215. Grace, owner, Butter & Rye
cases.note: A safety issue leads with who is at risk and what to do, before the sorry. Check with your local food safety authority whether you need to report it.

cases.situation: Two weeks ago our dog daycare's only van broke down and about 40 dogs got home up to three hours late. My apology post promised an update by Thursday 1 October on what we'd change. We now have a second van on standby and owners get a text if a drop-off runs over 20 minutes late. Everyone affected was refunded for that day. I'm the owner, Jade.
cases.reply: As promised in my apology post, here's the update. When our van broke down two weeks ago, about 40 of your dogs got home up to three hours late. What's changed: a second van is now on standby every day, and if a drop-off is running more than 20 minutes late you'll get a text straight away with a new time. All 40 families have been refunded for that day. If anything still isn't right, email me at jade@example.com and I'll reply personally. Jade, owner
cases.note: The follow-up post is the promise kept: short recap, what changed, what's done. No second round of apologies.

cases.situation: 我们是一家奶茶店，发朋友圈和小红书说9月29日全天第二杯半价，结果下午2点原料就用完了，很多人白跑一趟，评论里有人说我们骗流量。以后做活动会写清限量多少杯，卖完马上在门口和线上通知。我是店主阿杰。
cases.reply: 9月29日我们说好全天第二杯半价，结果下午2点原料就用完了，之后来的朋友都白跑了一趟。对不起，说了全天就该做到全天。当天没买上的朋友，10月8日前到店说一声，第二杯半价照样给您补上，不需要任何凭证。以后做活动，我们会写清限量多少杯，卖完第一时间在门口和线上同步。有问题直接私信店铺，我本人回复。店主 阿杰
cases.note: 活动没兑现也是公开道歉：先说承诺了什么、哪里没做到，一句道歉，补偿不设门槛，改进只写一条做得到的。

cases.situation: We run Smoke & Salt, a barbecue food truck. At the Riverside Park festival on Saturday 26 September our card payments failed from 1pm to 4pm because of an outage at our payment provider, and with no sign up, people queued up to 30 minutes before learning we were cash only. We now carry a backup card reader on a different network and put a cash-only sign up the moment payments fail, and anyone who queued gets a free plate at the Harbour Market on Saturday 10 October. I'm the owner, Marcus, and questions can go to marcus@example.com.
cases.reply: At the Riverside Park festival on Saturday 26 September, our card payments stopped working from 1pm to 4pm, and because we didn't put a sign up, many of you queued for up to half an hour before finding out we could only take cash. Sorry, that's on us. We now carry a backup card reader on a different network, and a cash-only sign goes up the moment payments fail. If you queued that afternoon, come to our truck at the Harbour Market on Saturday 10 October and your plate is on us; just tell us you were there. Questions: marcus@example.com. Marcus, owner
cases.note: The outage started with a supplier, but the post owns what was ours: no backup and no sign. Blaming a vendor in public reads as an excuse.

cases.situation: We run a weekly veg box scheme with about 2,300 subscribers. At 7am today a test email saying 'Your subscription has been cancelled' went to everyone by mistake. Nothing was actually cancelled or charged differently, and we've since set it up so test emails can only go to a staff-only list. I'm the owner, Owen.
cases.reply:
Subject: Your veg box is not cancelled
Hi everyone,
At 7 this morning we sent all 2,300 of you an email saying your subscription had been cancelled. It wasn't: that was a test message that went to the real list by mistake, and nothing about your box, delivery day or payment has changed. Sorry for the fright, that one's on me. Test emails can now only go to a staff-only list, so it can't happen this way again. If anything looks wrong on your account, reply here and I'll check it personally.
Owen, owner
cases.note: A false alarm: the reassurance goes in the subject line and first lines, and the apology stays as small as the mistake.

cases.situation: I own Juniper Café. On Sunday one of our staff told a mum who was breastfeeding to cover up or leave, and she posted about it in the local community Facebook group, where it has 200 comments. I've apologised to her privately, spoken with the staff member, and briefed the whole team that breastfeeding is welcome anywhere in the café. People can email me at nina@example.com. I'm Nina.
cases.reply: On Sunday, a mum feeding her baby at Juniper Café was told by one of our team to cover up or leave. That should never have happened here, and I'm sorry, to her and to every parent reading this who now wonders if they're welcome. I've apologised to her directly and spoken with the staff member. The whole team has been briefed: breastfeeding is welcome anywhere in the café. If anything like this happens to you here, please email me at nina@example.com and I'll deal with it myself. Nina, owner
cases.note: Owned as the café, with no staff name and no name for the mum, whose choice it is to speak up in the thread.

cases.situation: I'm Ruth, licensee of The Copper Lantern pub. On Saturday 26 September a private birthday party in our beer garden ran loud until 12:40am, well past our 11pm garden closing, and three households on Elm Row came round to complain on Sunday. I want to put a letter through every door on Elm Row: from now on the garden closes at 10:30pm with a staff member checking it's empty, we've stopped taking garden bookings after 9pm, and people can reach me at ruth@example.com or at the bar.
cases.reply:
Dear neighbours,
On Saturday 26 September a private party in our beer garden carried on loudly until 12:40am, well past our 11pm closing time for the garden. That kept many of you awake, and I'm sorry. It was our job to close it on time and we didn't. From now on the garden closes at 10:30pm, a member of staff checks it's empty, and we no longer take garden bookings after 9pm. If anything from the pub disturbs you, email me at ruth@example.com or ask for me at the bar and I'll deal with it myself.
Ruth, licensee, The Copper Lantern
cases.note: The public here is the street, not social media: a letter through the door reaches exactly the people affected.

cases.situation: I run Pedal & Pine, a bike rental shop. On 22 September I posted on Instagram that a booking-system glitch 'didn't charge anyone twice'. Yesterday our statements showed 48 customers were charged twice, $35 each; we refunded all 48 this morning, which should show within 10 business days, by 14 October. We now check each day's charges against bookings before closing. I'm the owner, Leo, and people can email leo@example.com.
cases.reply: A correction to my post on 22 September: I said our booking glitch hadn't charged anyone twice. That was wrong. 48 of you were charged twice for a rental, $35 each, and I'm sorry, both for the charge and for telling you it hadn't happened. All 48 refunds went out this morning, no action needed. From now on we check each day's charges against bookings before we close. If you were charged twice and the refund hasn't appeared by Wednesday 14 October, email me at leo@example.com. Leo, owner.
cases.note: Correcting your own earlier statement: say what you got wrong first and apologise for both the error and the false reassurance.

cases.situation: I'm Tom, chef at Harvest Table, a supper club. We served 48 guests on Saturday 26 September and 11 have told us they've had vomiting and diarrhoea since. Environmental health inspected yesterday and we don't have results yet; we've paused all events, are refunding all 48 guests in full today, and our inbox is hello@example.com.
cases.reply: If you ate at our Harvest Table dinner on Saturday 26 September and are still unwell, please see a doctor, and if symptoms are severe, call emergency services. Eleven of the 48 guests have told us they've been ill since, with vomiting and diarrhoea. I'm Tom, the chef, and I'm sorry. We've paused all events, environmental health inspected our kitchen yesterday, and we don't yet know the cause. All 48 guests are being refunded in full today, with nothing you need to do. We'll post here what the inspection finds and what we change before we cook for anyone again. To talk to me directly, email hello@example.com.
cases.note: Health incident: lead with what anyone still ill should do, say plainly that the cause is unknown, and promise only the update.

cases.situation: I'm Claire, manager of The Tamarind Room, a 300-capacity music venue. On Saturday 26 September a setup error in our ticketing sold 380 tickets, and we turned about 70 people away at the door because we can't go over capacity. Everyone turned away gets a full automatic refund by Friday 2 October plus free entry to any show before 31 December, which we'll email them how to claim; capacity is now locked in the ticket system and two of us check it before sales open, and people can reach me at claire@example.com.
cases.reply: On Saturday 26 September we sold 380 tickets for a room that holds 300, because of a setup error in our ticketing, and about 70 of you were turned away at the door after coming out for the show. I'm sorry, that's on us. Everyone turned away gets a full refund automatically by Friday 2 October, plus free entry to any show before 31 December; we'll email you how to claim it. Capacity is now locked in our ticket system and two of us check it before any sale opens. Turned away and not heard from us by Friday? Email me at claire@example.com. Claire, venue manager.
cases.note: Don't apologise for refusing entry over capacity; the mistake was selling the tickets, so own that.

cases.situation: 我叫阿梅，开了一家手工辣酱小店。详情页和包装上一直写“全程手工制作”，有顾客在小红书发视频指出我们灌装用的是半自动机器：辣椒的剁和炒确实是手工，灌装和封口是机器。详情页今天已经改成“手工炒制，机器灌装”，11月起的新包装也换这句话；买过的顾客觉得被误导的，10月10日前私信店铺可以全额退款，不用退货；以后宣传文字发出前我会对照实际工序逐句核对。我的微信是 amei_lajiao。
cases.reply: 我们的详情页和包装一直写着“全程手工制作”，这不准确：辣椒的剁和炒是手工，但灌装和封口用的是半自动机器。对不起，是我们写得不实，让大家误会了。详情页今天已经改成“手工炒制，机器灌装”，11月起的新包装也会换成这句话。买过的朋友如果觉得被误导，10月10日前私信店铺，全额退款，不用退货。以后所有宣传文字发出前，我都会对照实际工序逐句核对。有问题加我微信 amei_lajiao，我本人回复。店主 阿梅
cases.note: 宣传说法不实的道歉：先把真实情况说清楚，不辩解“其实大部分是手工”，退款不设门槛。

cases.situation: I'm Dan, race director of the Riverside 10K, a community run with 640 finishers on Sunday 27 September. A turn point was set up in the wrong place, so the course was about 9.4km and the times can't count as personal bests or for club rankings. Results will go up marked as short course, everyone who entered gets free entry to our 5K on Sunday 15 November by an emailed code, and from now on two of us walk and measure the course the day before and every marshal gets a map with their exact spot. Questions to dan@example.com.
cases.reply: At the Riverside 10K on Sunday 27 September, a turn point was set up in the wrong place, so the course all 640 of you ran was about 9.4km, not 10. That means Sunday's times can't count as personal bests or for club rankings. Sorry, that's on us as organisers. Results will go up marked as short course, and everyone who entered gets free entry to our 5K on Sunday 15 November; we'll email you a code. From now on two of us walk and measure the course the day before, and every marshal gets a map with their exact spot. Questions: dan@example.com. Dan, race director
cases.note: Owned by the organisers, with no volunteer blamed; the hard news (no PBs) goes early so nobody has to read between the lines.

cases.situation: 京都で和菓子のネットショップをしています。敬老の日（9月21日）に届くはずだった贈答用の詰め合わせ約120件が、こちらの出荷作業の遅れで9月23日の到着になりました。対象のお客様には送料を10月5日までに自動で全額返金し、今後は記念日ギフトの出荷を3日前倒しにします。店主の山田で、問い合わせはyamada@example.com で受けたいです。
cases.reply: 敬老の日（9月21日）にお届けするはずだった贈答用の詰め合わせ約120件が、当店の出荷作業の遅れにより、9月23日の到着となりました。大切な日に間に合わせられず、申し訳ございません。店主の山田です。対象のお客様には、10月5日（月）までに送料を全額返金いたします。お手続きは不要です。今後、記念日向けのギフトは出荷を3日前倒しにいたします。ご不明な点は yamada@example.com までご連絡ください。私が直接お返事します。
cases.note: お詫びを何度も重ねたくなる場面でも、謝罪は一度、あとは事実と対応を具体的に書く。

cases.situation: I'm Helen Gray, director of Eastgate Food Share, a small charity. Our newsletter on Tuesday 29 September, emailed to about 1,800 supporters and posted on our website, included a photo of a family collecting food, and they had never agreed to it; a friend of theirs recognised them and complained on Facebook. I've taken the photo off the website and apologised to the family privately, and from now on no photo of anyone we support goes out without a signed consent form checked by a second person. Supporters can reach me at helen@example.com.
cases.reply: Our newsletter on Tuesday 29 September, emailed to about 1,800 supporters and posted on our website, included a photo of a family collecting food who had never agreed to it. That should not have happened, and I'm sorry, to that family first and to everyone who trusts us with their dignity when they come to us for help. The photo is off our website and I've apologised to the family directly. An email can't be recalled, so if you still have that newsletter, please delete it rather than forward it. From now on no photo of anyone we support is used without a signed consent form, checked by a second person before anything goes out. Questions: helen@example.com. Helen Gray, director, Eastgate Food Share
cases.note: A charity's mistake about the people it serves: never name or describe the family again, ask readers for the one thing that still limits the harm, and check your data protection reporting duties.

cases.situation: I'm Priya, owner of Lark & Loom, an online homeware shop. From 24 to 29 September the chat assistant on our website told about 35 customers that sale items could be returned for a full refund, but our policy is store credit only on sale items; we're honouring full refunds for anyone who asks before 31 October. The assistant now answers only from our written returns policy and hands every returns question to a person, and people can reach me at priya@example.com.
cases.reply: From 24 to 29 September, the chat assistant on our website told about 35 of you that sale items could be returned for a full refund. That was wrong: our policy is store credit on sale items. But you heard it from us, so it stands, and I'm sorry for the mix-up. If you were told this, you can return your sale item for a full refund any time before 31 October; just mention the chat when you start the return. The assistant now answers only from our written returns policy, and every returns question goes to a person. Questions: priya@example.com. Priya, owner, Lark & Loom
cases.note: An automated tool speaks for the business, so own what it said and honour it rather than blaming the software.

cases.situation: Soy Pilar, dueña de la librería La Hoja Suelta, en Sevilla. El lunes anunciamos en Instagram la ganadora del sorteo de un lote de 10 libros, pero el comentario elegido llegó después del cierre del domingo a las 23:59, así que la ganadora es otra persona. Ya le escribimos a la ganadora correcta, la persona anunciada el lunes también recibe un lote porque se lo prometimos, y desde ahora sorteamos sobre una captura de los comentarios hecha al cierre. Mi correo es pilar@example.com.
cases.reply: El lunes anunciamos la ganadora del sorteo del lote de 10 libros, pero nos equivocamos: el comentario elegido llegó después del cierre del domingo a las 23:59. Lo sentimos, el error fue nuestro al hacer el sorteo. Ya hemos escrito a la ganadora correcta, y la persona que anunciamos el lunes también recibe su lote, porque se lo prometimos. A partir de ahora sortearemos sobre una captura de los comentarios hecha justo al cierre. Cualquier duda, escribidme a pilar@example.com. Pilar, La Hoja Suelta
cases.note: Un error pequeño y público se corrige en el mismo sitio, sin nombrar a nadie, cumpliendo lo prometido y con un cambio comprobable.

cases.situation: 我是网店“青禾家纺”的店主苏晴。9月客服同事离职，我没及时安排人接手，大约430条售后留言等了5到12天才回复，有人在小红书上说我们“卖完就不管”。积压的留言现在已经全部回完；9月等过回复的客人，退换货运费由我们出，退款时一起退回，不用另外申请；从10月起我每天亲自看售后留言，48小时内回复。
cases.reply: 9月里，大约430位客人的售后留言等了5到12天才得到回复，这是我们的问题，对不起。原因是客服同事离职后，我没有及时安排人接手。积压的留言现在已经全部回复完。9月等过回复的客人，这次退换货的运费由我们出，退款时一起退回，不用另外申请。从这个月起，售后留言我每天亲自看，48小时内回复。还有问题没解决的，直接私信店铺，我本人跟进。店主 苏晴
cases.note: 原因只说一句，不怪离职的同事；承诺的是能做到的“48小时内回复”，不是“再也不会”。

cases.situation: I'm Sam Okoro, founder of Fernleaf, an online plant shop. A customer emailed yesterday that by changing the number in our order-tracking link she could see other customers' names, delivery addresses and phone numbers; it had been like that since a site update on 21 September, and about 2,600 orders were viewable. No payment details or passwords are on that page. We fixed it within an hour of her email, the tracking page now asks for the email address used on the order, and I want to email every affected customer; questions can go to sam@example.com.
cases.reply:
Subject: A problem with our order-tracking page, and what we've done
Hi,
From 21 September until yesterday, a fault in our order-tracking page meant that anyone who changed the number in a tracking link could see other customers' names, delivery addresses and phone numbers. About 2,600 orders could be viewed this way, and yours was one of them. No payment details or passwords were on that page. I'm sorry. A customer reported it to us yesterday and we fixed it within the hour; the tracking page now asks for the email address used on the order. Please be wary of texts or calls claiming to be from Fernleaf that ask for payment, and if one feels off, check with me at sam@example.com first.
Sam Okoro, founder, Fernleaf
cases.note: Check your legal notification duties in every region you sell to before sending; say exactly what was and wasn't exposed, and give the one precaution that matters.

cases.situation: 我们是两人小团队“微光工作室”，去年在众筹平台上众筹一款木制台灯，承诺今年6月发货，共1260位支持者。因为低估了模具开发，到现在还没发货，7月之后也一直没更新进度，评论区很多人在骂。现在模具已经通过，11月20日前能全部发出；不想等的支持者10月31日前私信申请可全额退款；以后每月15日发一次进度更新。我是创始人何川。
cases.reply: 各位支持者，我是微光工作室的何川。我们承诺6月发货的木制台灯到今天还没有发出，而且7月以后一直没有更新进度，这两件事都是我们的错，对不起。延误的原因是我们低估了模具开发；现在模具已经通过，1260台会在11月20日前全部发出。不想再等的朋友，10月31日前私信我们申请，全额退款。从这个月起，每月15日我们都会发一次进度更新，有任何问题可以直接私信我。
cases.note: 众筹延期要连“沉默不更新”一起认，并给出能兑现的固定更新日期。

cases.situation: I'm Leah, owner of Bloom Lane, a flower shop. In March we let customers opt out of Mother's Day emails, but the opt-out only covered emails sent in the weeks before Mother's Day, so on Thursday 1 October our 'Treat Mum' autumn promotion went to the 340 people who had opted out, and several replied hurt; some have lost their mothers. Opt-outs now cover every mum-themed email all year, and I want to email just those 340.
cases.reply:
Subject: Yesterday's email, and an apology
Hi,
You asked us not to send you Mother's Day emails, and yesterday we sent you our 'Treat Mum' promotion anyway. Your opt-out only covered the weeks before Mother's Day, and we didn't think beyond that. I'm sorry; for some of you that email will have landed on something painful. Your opt-out now covers every mum-themed email we send, all year round. If you'd like to tell me anything, or stop hearing from us altogether, just reply and I'll read it myself.
Leah, owner, Bloom Lane
cases.note: Write only to the people affected, own the gap in your own setup, and keep the sorry quiet and single, with no promotion attached.

cases.situation: 我是“山野小铺”的店主王岚，我们在网上卖家乡土特产。10月1日晚上直播时，主播模仿一位外地顾客的口音开玩笑，被截成视频在小红书上转了不少，很多人说看了不舒服。回放已经删了，我已私信向那位顾客道歉，也跟主播谈过；以后每场直播都会有第二个人在场，出现不合适的话当场纠正、当场道歉。
cases.reply: 10月1日晚上的直播里，我们的主播模仿一位外地顾客的口音开玩笑。这不好笑，也不尊重人，很多看到的朋友都觉得不舒服。对不起，这是我们店的直播，责任在我。直播回放已经删除，我已经私下向这位顾客道歉，也跟主播谈过了。以后每场直播都会有第二个人在场，出现不合适的话当场纠正、当场道歉。想跟我说说的，直接私信店铺，我本人回复。店主 王岚
cases.note: 不点名主播，也不再提那位顾客是谁，责任由店铺承担；改进只写一条每场都做得到的。

cases.situation: I'm Ines, founder of Hollowtree, a small online knitwear brand. From 7 to 28 September the size guide for our new Ridge jumper listed chest measurements one size too small, so about 150 customers ordered a size too big. Anyone who bought a Ridge in that window can exchange it with free postage both ways until 30 November, or return it for a full refund; the guide is fixed, every new size guide is now checked against a sample garment before it goes live, and questions can go to ines@example.com.
cases.reply: From 7 to 28 September, the size guide for our new Ridge jumper listed chest measurements one size too small, so about 150 of you ordered a size too big. Sorry, that was our mistake, not yours. If you bought a Ridge in that window, you can exchange it with free postage both ways until 30 November, or return it for a full refund. The guide is now fixed, and every new size guide is checked against a sample garment before it goes live. Questions: ines@example.com. Ines, founder, Hollowtree
cases.note: A small, contained error: what was wrong and who it hit, one sorry, an easy fix both ways, and one check you can keep.

cases.situation: I'm Rosa, owner of Millbrook Bakehouse; we supply bread and pastries wholesale to 28 local cafés. On Monday we switched to a new delivery route we hadn't test-driven, and 11 cafés got their 7am delivery after 10am, after their breakfast rush. Those 11 get Monday's order credited in full on their next invoice, any future route change gets a full test drive the week before, and late deliveries now trigger a text by 7:15 with a new time; I want to email all 28 cafés, and I'm on 0161 496 0418 or rosa@example.com.
cases.reply:
Subject: Monday's late deliveries, and what we've changed
Hi all,
On Monday, 11 of you got your 7am delivery after 10am, well after your breakfast rush. That was our new delivery route, which we hadn't test-driven, and I'm sorry. If you were one of the 11, Monday's order is credited in full on your next invoice, with nothing to do on your side. From now on any route change gets a full test drive the week before, and if a delivery is running late you'll get a text by 7:15 with a new time. To reach me directly, call 0161 496 0418 or email rosa@example.com.
Rosa, owner, Millbrook Bakehouse
cases.note: Business customers get the same shape as the public: what happened, one sorry, an automatic credit, and changes they can see at their own door.

cases.situation: I'm Farah, co-founder of Quillmark, a 12-person design studio. We advertised a junior designer role in August, about 210 people applied, and none of them heard back because the role was put on hold and nobody on our side owned closing the process; one applicant posted about it on LinkedIn. The role reopens on Monday 12 October, August applicants will be considered without reapplying unless they tell us to withdraw them, from now on every applicant gets a reply within two weeks even if it's a no, and questions can go to farah@example.com.
cases.reply: In August we advertised a junior designer role at Quillmark, about 210 of you applied, and not one of you heard back from us. Applying takes real time and you deserved an answer, so I'm sorry. The role was put on hold and nobody on our side owned telling you; that's on us as a studio. It reopens on Monday 12 October, and if you applied in August you'll be considered without reapplying; just email me if you'd rather we withdrew your application. From now on every applicant gets a reply within two weeks, even if it's a no. Questions: farah@example.com. Farah, co-founder, Quillmark
cases.note: The public here is job applicants, not customers: own the silence as the studio, name no one, and make the fix a reply time you can keep.
